castles, caves and wherever you
and your pals go, Wataru-kun.

I'll ask whether you want
to save your game.

I'll save it for you!

ファイルを方向キーで選び、
○ボタンで決定するだけよ。

On the save screen, use the
D-pad to choose a file to save,
then press Circle to confirm.
